gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.live_model: the operator's own installed, signed-in kiro-cli over ACP with model "auto"; the replies on screen are that model's and vary from run to run
agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway ran Kiro Crew at the App Kit level-1 seams commit with its built-in Papyrus (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/papyrus and the papyrus-* builtin skills) removed from that throwaway checkout, and served this repository installed from a clean clone of the commit named in app_commit, trusted and enabled through the dashboard API. The compiler is the app's own managed Tectonic, installed through the app's 'Install compiler' route.
data_notes: Every paper, person, journal and citation is fictional; the bibliography entries do not refer to real publications.
Each paper's 'Last edited' time is the moment the capture created it, from the gateway's clock.
The grazing-abstract paper is seeded with an undefined macro (\tempdiff) on purpose, to show the compiler's error list.
